theorem subset_iInf_iff_forall_normalClosure_subset {G : Type*} [Group G] {I : Type*}
  (T : Set G) (H : I → Subgroup G) (hNormal : ∀ i : I, (H i).Normal) :
  (∀ i : I, T ⊆ (H i : Set G)) ↔
    ∀ S : Set G, S ⊆ (Subgroup.normalClosure T : Set G) →
      Subgroup.normalClosure S ≤ ⨅ i : I, H i := by
  constructor
  · intro h S hS
    haveI : (Subgroup.normalClosure T).Normal := Subgroup.normalClosure_normal
    have hS_le : Subgroup.normalClosure S ≤ Subgroup.normalClosure T :=
      Subgroup.normalClosure_le_normal hS
    have hT_le : Subgroup.normalClosure T ≤ ⨅ i, H i := by
      refine le_iInf fun i => ?_
      haveI := hNormal i
      exact Subgroup.normalClosure_le_normal (h i)
    exact hS_le.trans hT_le
  · intro h i x hx
    have hT : Subgroup.normalClosure T ≤ ⨅ j, H j := h T Subgroup.subset_normalClosure
    have h_le : Subgroup.normalClosure T ≤ H i := hT.trans (iInf_le H i)
    exact h_le (Subgroup.subset_normalClosure hx)
